Data Import and Export

import_and_export.Rmd

Formats

The currently available formats are:

  • metabolon_v1
  • metabolon_v2
  • metaboprep1
  • metaboprep2
  • nightingale_v1
  • nightingale_v2

Exporting processed data 

# data file
file <- system.file("extdata", "metabolon_v2_example.xlsx", package = "metaboprep2")

# Metabolites object
metabolites <- Metabolites(project_name = "metaboprep_v2_example",
                           format       = "metabolon_v2",
                           filepath     = file)

# Import
metabolites <- import_data(metabolites)
#> Using cached MetaboAnalyst DB.
#> Attempting join [features$hmdb] ~ [annotation$hmdb_id] 
#> Attempting join [features$kegg] ~ [annotation$kegg_id] 
#> Attempting join [features$biochemical] ~ [annotation$name] 
#> Attempting join [features$pubchem] ~ [annotation$pubchem_id]

# Run some QC
metabolites <- metabolite_qc(metabolites, source="raw")
#>

# Export to directory
export_data(metabolites, directory = getwd())

Importing metaboprep2 format 

metabolites <- Metabolites(project_name = "import_previous",
                           format       = "metaboprep2",
                           filepath     = output_dir)

metabolites <- import_data(metabolites)

metabolites
